reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 21. Not Voting: 0. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Today, I had a town hall with AP Government students at Wake STEM Early College High School. 

We discussed the legislative process, my work in Congress, and how to best represent Wake County constituents. Thank you to the students for a warm welcome and your great questions. https://t.co/6uoMt9mdxU

Healthcare costs are too high.

Only 48 days until a Democratic majority in Congress that will prioritize lowering costs for everyday Americans. Until then, the work continues. https://t.co/GUsFxumofQ

Meet Representative-Elect Paul Barringer, a lawyer, farmer and Sunday School teacher from Lee County.  He will represent the 13th district (just outside of Wake County) and I'm excited to work together to deliver for North Carolinians. https://t.co/Hj5g3zDZEW

Please join me in welcoming Representative-elect Chuck Hubbard to North Carolina's delegation. 

He's coming to Congress to lower costs and protect the rights of all Americans.

I am confident he will represent North Carolina's 5th district well. https://t.co/OWCvzI6HTS

Our nation’s veterans should never have faced exposure to toxic water during their time stationed at Camp Lejeune.

It's time to put politics aside and deliver the justice they deserve now. https://t.co/vJYVGmBMAT

Meet Representative-elect Cyril Jefferson, High Point's accomplished mayor and seasoned small business owner.

He will be a fierce defender of North Carolina's 6th district. https://t.co/7DYNBuVaE9

Today, I voted to pass the Major Richard Star Act. 

This will help thousands of veterans who retired early due to injury get their full retirement pay + VA disability compensation.

Veterans have waited years for Congress to pass this bill. It's time we deliver for them.

I am ready to rein in Trump's war with Iran to lower gas prices in North Carolina.

It's time to end the rubberstamp on Trump's agenda from Republicans in Congress. https://t.co/bWWIh9tjZ4

Representative-elect Jamie Ager is a fourth-generation farmer and an entrepreneur who will fight for North Carolina families. 

I look forward to working with Jamie as one of the newest members of our North Carolina delegation. https://t.co/PiULWuRvfr

Voters delivered a clear mandate for the next Congress: lower costs and make life easier for Americans.

Trump’s war and tariffs are wildly unpopular. In the majority, Democrats will reclaim our authority and put an end to his harmful policies.

https://t.co/oEFBD5MR7L

After last week's election results, it's evident the tides are turning. 
 
Now it's time we address rising costs, the healthcare crisis, and corruption. https://t.co/j7oLgJLr0E

On Veterans Day, we honor those who have served our country with strength and bravery.

To our Veterans: we owe you an immeasurable debt of gratitude. Thank you for your service. https://t.co/l0Z3jVoRkk

Congrats to @NCGOP on becoming the encyclopedia example of a dummymander. I hope this will motivate you to spend less time suppressing voters and more time delivering for them! https://t.co/VuFNx3MaYJ

Looks like prices keep rising thanks to Trump's tariffs and war of choice with Iran.

REMINDER: NC-02 families have already spent an additional $3,800 on everyday essentials since Trump has taken office. Enough is enough.

https://t.co/xl4AkFnVVY

History is watching.

It's time we crack down on the rampant corruption running wild in the Trump administration. https://t.co/T5jd2Bw235
The people of North Carolina are about to have much better representation here in Washington, D.C. https://t.co/baAJOI5HD2

BREAKING: Trump's admin announced they plan to cut food assistance for 6.3 million more Americans.

Let's be clear: this is completely voluntary.

Americans spoke out against the cruelty of this admin and instead of listening, they doubled down on making life harder.

The American people have spoken, and they are demanding accountability for the Trump administration's corrupt actions. 
 
Now, we can deliver for them. https://t.co/TXmfsUxZyN

Diwali is a day to celebrate the triumph of light over darkness.

Wishing a happy Diwali to those celebrating in Wake County and beyond. https://t.co/ZXgpT1jtfX

The racist, anti-Indian protests at a Diwali event in Seattle are despicable and must be unequivocally condemned. To those in the Indian-American community, please know I stand with you amidst a terrifying rise in anti-Indian sentiment in the US.
 
I hope those celebrating Diwali

Ahead of Veterans’ Day, @ValerieFoushee and I spoke with veterans in our community about the services and support available to them in North Carolina.

We make a promise to our service members to stand with them when they put on a uniform. It is our duty to care for them when they return home.
It’s a new day in the great state of North Carolina. Now, it’s time to deliver results that make life easier for people across our state. https://t.co/To94QBSZHJ

Prices have skyrocketed under Trump and Republicans, thanks to his tariffs, the war in Iran, and massive cuts to essential services.

Next Congress, Democrats’ #1 priority is bringing down the cost of living to make life more affordable for all Americans. https://t.co/pg5IyspvIB

Trump always chickens out.

The President knows his policies are unpopular. When Democrats win the majority, he’ll be forced to back down. https://t.co/vscBFWY0wq

The Trump admin and Republicans in Congress have forced 100,000 people in NC off Medicaid and willingly let the ACA tax credits expire. New work requirements in 2027 will leave even more without coverage.

Families should not have to sacrifice necessities to get the care they https://t.co/vhMHhuqJa2

It was great to attend the groundbreaking ceremony for Chapanoke, a new affordable housing development here in Raleigh!

The number one issue I hear about from my constituents is the rising cost of housing. I will keep working to make sure that the people who contribute to our https://t.co/GZnHdnVcqw

This Sunday, I celebrated Día de los Muertos with Revista Latina NC.

I was grateful to join our Latin American community in Raleigh to celebrate this beautiful tradition honoring our loved ones. https://t.co/axlGVLyoHS

When Kathleen went to pick up her prescription, she was shocked to hear that her Medicare Part D plan was terminated.

She only owed $14, but now she's unable to get her benefits for the rest of the year.

Seniors should not be forced to go months without life-saving medication because of payment changes. I introduced a bill to give people like Kathleen a pathway to re-enroll in Medicare Part D.

Today, I met with parents, caregivers, and educators to discuss the rising costs of childcare. 

The consensus was clear: families and providers need more resources to succeed - not less. https://t.co/BZ7bugFgMj

When Democrats win the majority, Trump will have nowhere to hide.

We will work to end the President’s war of choice in Iran, reverse Medicaid cuts, and lower costs for Americans.

https://t.co/xXC76Dkf5p

Electricity costs have gone up more than twice as fast as the overall cost of living in North Carolina.

I met with elected officials and energy leaders to discuss rising utility costs and Duke Energy’s plan to raise residential rates.

Electricity isn’t a luxury item. I will https://t.co/eAHbupPM9X

Congratulations to William Peace University for receiving nearly $3 million in Title III grant funding!

I had a great time on campus speaking with students about issues that matter most to them ahead of the midterm elections. https://t.co/DFAVcdBNIn

Our state's economic growth has been fueled by innovation, but much of this progress has been halted by tariffs and other disastrous policies by this administration. I was grateful for a meaningful dialogue with the Wake Forest Chamber of Commerce about how we can work together to support Wake Forest’s small businesses.

Instead of delivering long-overdue justice to Camp Lejeune victims, Trump is dragging them into a political fight, threatening to withhold settlement money if Republicans lose in North Carolina.

Justice for Camp Lejeune victims isn't a partisan issue. Sick and grieving families

Americans paid an additional $310 for groceries in 2025.

The President’s cuts to care and food assistance are hurting Americans across the board. And Republicans in Congress have voted again and again for these cuts, knowing that they would raise your costs. https://t.co/gRYLdIY9iA

“Customers [are] getting less than what they were previously, even if their bills haven’t changed.”

Families and small businesses are paying the price for this economy as Trump and House Republicans refuse to put Americans first.

I picked up a few groceries at Grand Asia Market

President Trump has cost NC-02 families more than $3,800 this year.

Despite his promises to end inflation and lower costs, North Carolina families are still paying for his broken promises. https://t.co/pu7QqeOJkB

Same grocery bill, smaller cart.

I visited Grand Asia Market in Raleigh to talk with owner Richard Chang about how reckless tariffs and high fuel prices are driving up costs for both families and small businesses. https://t.co/ik1HeZ78uX

Trump's warnings that there would be “no money” for settlements for Camp Lejeune victims if the GOP loses the midterms are repulsive. Veterans and families still seeking justice for loved ones have been through enough before being coerced to vote with Trump in order to get fair https://t.co/YOvojPNnOb

Dear James-David, I'm glad our airport made such a strong impression on you, because the city of "Raleigh-Durham" would like you to go back to DC and restore our research funding. https://t.co/n43MkeeqAC

Prices aren't rising by accident. Republicans have voted with Trump to raise the cost of healthcare, food, gas, and more.

I spoke about how I'm working to lower costs at my town hall Wednesday in West Raleigh. North Carolina deserves leaders who work for them, not against them. https://t.co/DXlaYnQop6

The Raleigh-to-Richmond Rail Line is a testament to what we can achieve when federal, state, and local leaders work together. 

By investing in a more efficient transportation system, we are building the infrastructure needed to support our state's growing population and economy. https://t.co/LLPJYqRUNX

I am horrified to learn about the attempted mass shooting at a Hindu temple over the weekend, and I am grateful that @CongressmanRaja and his family are safe.

The threats of white supremacy and anti-Indian hate must be taken seriously and unequivocally condemned. My heart goes out to our Hindu and Indian communities in North Carolina and beyond in the wake of this frightening attack.

Congratulations to North Carolina's own Christina Koch on becoming NASA’s acting deputy chief engineer.
 
Christina Koch made our state proud as the first woman to journey around the moon. Now, I look forward to working with her as she leads the next chapter of American space travel.
 
https://t.co/BUr9e3aMsu

Unlike this pumpkin, your plan to vote shouldn’t be up in the air. Early voting in North Carolina starts TODAY, October 15th. 

Check your voter registration and make a plan to vote! https://t.co/mBFHO1BlGE

Thanks to high energy costs, inflation rose to 3.7%.

Americans can't keep up with continuously rising prices. But instead of working to lower costs, Republicans in Washington have voted for Trump’s tariffs, supported his war with Iran, and backed policies that are driving up costs for American families.

https://t.co/9wKITaUgy4

It was an honor to welcome German Ambassador to the United States, Jens Hanefeld, to North Carolina.

Ambassador Hanefeld's visit highlighted our countries' shared goals and the opportunities ahead to strengthen the partnership between North Carolina and Germany. https://t.co/lM2KkP0Asy

I was delighted to attend Hum Sub’s Annual Diwali celebration in Cary this weekend!

Hum Sub is a pillar of our community, and it is always inspiring to join them each year for Diwali. I look forward to many joyous celebrations in the years to come. https://t.co/819xZHoMKb

Every single vote counts.

Early voting begins in North Carolina on October 15th. Make a plan to vote now. https://t.co/OqgQnawOEF

As our community faces rising prices on everything from healthcare to energy, I want to hear from you. I am hosting an in-person town hall this Wednesday, 10/14 at 6:30 PM in West Raleigh.

RSVP using the link below:

https://t.co/uvSwQvPU2r https://t.co/5d1Hr6cNdh

"I sit on the couch watching football and doing laundry. And thank God for the alerts. I'll say that first and foremost.”

I’m grateful that Hurricane Isaias left no reported fatalities across North Carolina. This is in no small part thanks to the National Weather Service (NWS), which provided alerts that mobilized people to safety in a matter of minutes. 

This is why in Congress I will keep fighting back against cuts to NWS to make sure families have the info they need when extreme weather strikes.

https://t.co/H2BHtVRjC8

Today is Indigenous Peoples' Day, a day to celebrate the rich history and important contributions of Native communities to North Carolina and beyond.

Indigenous communities have experienced centuries of injustice and discrimination yet continue to endure. Today, we honor them and recommit ourselves to pursuing justice.

posts.text:
Every single vote counts.

Early voting begins in North Carolina on October 15th. Make a plan to vote now. https://t.co/8cYIIOkUDA

It was an honor to join @NCLifeSci to discuss the future of life sciences in the Triangle.

I’m honored to represent so many businesses and organizations that are innovating across the life sciences sector. Investing in biosciences is an investment in North Carolina’s people and our future.

I'm proud to have earned an A from Defend the Vote for my record of protecting voting rights, fighting corruption, and defending election integrity.

Voting is our most fundamental right, and the Trump Administration is still trying to disenfranchise voters. I will always fight to ensure that every vote counts.

Starting January 1st, the Trump admin's new work requirements for Medicaid go into effect, jeopardizing coverage for thousands of North Carolinians and raising healthcare premiums across the board.

I held a roundtable with policymakers and providers to discuss what's at risk and what those with Medicaid should know.

In 2024, Republicans spent months trying to overturn the fair election of NC Justice Allison Riggs. 

Justice Riggs joined our shadow hearing to speak about their attempts at election interference. https://t.co/ijFhPVvwxw

It was a pleasure to speak with the American Bar Association’s GPSolo Division in Raleigh about fighting back against the weaponization of our legal system.

America’s lawyers are our first line of defense for the protection of the rule of law. https://t.co/47MQSEOKEk

Happy Bike, Walk, and Roll to School Day! 

It was great to join students and families this morning to support safe, active, and fun ways to get to school. https://t.co/aFYdFVbx8z

Three years ago, Hamas committed the deadliest attack on Jews since the Holocaust, killing nearly 1,200 Israelis and taking 251 more hostage—including several Americans. 

It is a devastating and complex day for Jewish Americans—and all Americans—as we navigate the ongoing humanitarian aftermath and the expanding conflict in the Middle East. 

Today and every day, we stand with the Jewish community in mourning the lives lost and condemning the surge in antisemitism that has erupted in the wake of this tragedy.

North Carolina is no stranger to attacks on election integrity, and the state legislature is still trying to rig the rules.

We will remain diligent and ensure that North Carolinians are guaranteed fair and equal access to the ballot box. https://t.co/AJ8nlqK92N

Survivors deserve better than political games.
 
While the Trump Administration has abandoned survivors of sexual assault with its cuts to Title IX, in Congress, I’m working with my female colleagues to address gender-based violence and deliver justice to survivors.
 
https://t.co/kZtKqVk3PO

The Supreme Court's new term begins today, and the cases before the court could fundamentally change the law on immigration, guns, religion and more.
 I will be monitoring these decisions closely and will share how they may impact you and your freedoms.
 
Read more about what’s on the docket: 
https://t.co/aAFR6KWD6c

Trump knows he can’t win a fair fight. That’s why he’s trying to insert as much uncertainty as possible into our elections before November.

We will not let him get away with it. https://t.co/T39IYG7IvY

Come along with me to Raleigh Wide Open!

Listen to over 40 artists from around the country, enjoy good food, and celebrate our community this weekend in downtown Raleigh. https://t.co/QDTq72MBMu
